authorization: 2026-09-06 user requested experiments showing existing calculation -> remaining judgment problem -> added calculation -> changed decision

scope.candidate_geometry: native ALS points; immutable tile row membership
scope.height_axis: SCENE_LOCAL_Z; coordinate component, not an estimated gravity claim
scope.camera_and_registration: fixed supplied values; uncertainty is not calibrated by this probe
scope.visibility: field-of-view only; current occlusion and free space are not verified
scope.candidate_availability: MVS excluded from this measurement; this is a controlled prior-only input setting, not proof of a natural MVS hole
scope.sampling_origin: historical P2 development prism originally selected using MVS-ALS relations; subgroup selection now uses prior geometry only
scope.truth: current metric truth of unshifted prior unknown; height offsets are test hypotheses, not current-error labels

groups.selection: group by patch_id and floor(XY/grid_size); lexicographic keys, uniformly spaced indices before any image measurement; uniformly spaced original rows within each group

views.selection: within historical frozen view list: descending fraction of sampled prior points in image, ascending distance to median prior point, image ID; no image score or MVS depth selection

measurement.score_summary: median ZNCC on identical native points and identical pairs across every tested height

comparison.boundary_rule: any compatible height on tested boundary -> unresolved boundary
comparison.missing_rule: no adequate common measurement or empty compatible set -> no support; retain reason
comparison.calibration_status: UNVALIDATED_SENSITIVITY_AXES; no winning threshold will be selected
comparison.parameter_provenance: 0.5 ZNCC and 2/3-60/20 degree conventions originate in earlier exploratory T2; 20 degree band was historically post-result adjusted. Other threshold/tolerance entries are sensitivity axes, not application specifications or calibrated accuracy. +/-2m tests mirror existing metre-scale controls; 0.125m samples a finite vertical hypothesis grid. Group/view caps are computational scope, chosen before image measurements.
